row.notes: Per-car engine/powertrain step (reads Turbo +0x5a0, FuelECU +0x548, GearBox +0x538, ERS +0x5a8, Engine +0x530, FuelTank +0x540 of the car). Engine power = Car_Spline_EvalObfuscated(engine +0x28 RevsPowerSpline, rpm / revs scale) * power scale / rpm. Active fuel mode scales live XOR-obfuscated in the FuelECU runtime object: +0x130^+0x138 fuel burn scale (it also scales the ERS exhaust power written to ERS (car+0x5a8) +0x1a2c = turbo +0x2fc * throttle * rpm * ExhaustPowerCoefficient (ERS +0x74) * burn scale; fuel flow is FuelTank +0x108, corrected per V1215), +0x140^+0x148 power scale, +0x150^+0x158 revs scale. FuelTank +0x100 < 0.08 with car flag +0x132 bit 2 clamps the throttle (fuel run-out). | car-b correction: the param is the per-car vehicle-dynamics system (its +0x18 = CarLive) and +0x80 is the Engine system (whose +8 = CarLive). Engine data offsets are system offsets (RevsPowerSpline at Engine+0x28). The +0x2208 switch is Engine TurboMode (Off 0, LagSpoof 1, Full 2), not an engine mode: Full multiplies drive torque by Turbo efficiency_factor +0x304. Drive torque = RevsPowerSpline(rad/s / revs_scale) x power_scale / rad/s; braking = RevsEngineBrakingSpline lerped by engine_braking_fraction +0x252c and the gear; ERS deploy = MaxDeployPower x modes[ers_mode].gear_modifier[gear] x (track or default) deploy factor, speed spline +0x88/+0x330. Also runs the BrakeECU ABS/TC spline lookups (car+0x550 +0x10/+0x1000). structs/CarEngine.h, CarErs.h. Also referenced by the lea 0x1409d60be in 0x1409d50b0 (per V1215)

verify.notes: V1215 The car-b reading is right: param+0x18 = CarLive, param+0x80 = Engine; drive torque from RevsPowerSpline (engine+0x28) at rad/s / revs scale x power scale / rad/s; Full TurboMode (engine+0x2208 == 2, reader +0x21f0) multiplies by Turbo [car+0x5a0]+0x304; braking lerp uses +0x252c and gear +0x680; ERS gear modifier at ers+0x1890 + mode*0x40 + gear*4. Drop the superseded 'engine mode +0x2208' wording. Extra ref: lea 0x1409d60be in 0x1409d50b0.
